caption: popcap's canal puzzler - throw gold from gondola to gondola and rebuild the city.
about: Venice deluxe dresses a throw-and-match puzzle in canal-city paint: gondolas drift across the screen carrying colored goods, and you fling pieces back up to build matching groups that cash into city restorations. Every cleared level rebuilds a landmark, which gives the loop a destination most popcap throwers never bothered with.
The deluxe pc build is pre-merger popcap stock that never reached the current stores, so the archive route is the way back in.
